description: Append the next unmodified text chunk to a temporary NodeSet2 upload created by begin_nodeset_upload. Pass upload_id exactly as returned by begin_nodeset_upload and chunk as the next consecutive XML text segment; send every chunk in original order without overlap, omission or reformatting. On success the result returns status=OK, upload_id and cumulative received_chars; UNKNOWN_UPLOAD_ID or UPLOAD_TOO_LARGE indicates the upload cannot continue. This tool only stages XML in temporary memory and does not parse or compare it yet.
name: append_nodeset_chunk
